text: Now we're going to learn about chord inversions, one chord at a time. So let's start with C. This is the C chord. First inversion, we're going to put the C up at the top. So we know the notes are C-E-G. This is why when you practice your chords, I want you to say what the name of the notes you're playing are out loud. E-G-C. Same notes only we're putting the C at the top. This is the first inversion, and this is the second inversion, G's on the bottom, C, and E. So we'll always play C-E-N-G when we play a C chord. Right now, play the C chord and the different inversions. Let's play the D minor chord, D-F-A. This is called root position. Now we're going to play the first inversion, D-F-N-A, F-A-D. We put the D at the top, A-D-F. We put the F at the top. These are the inversions of the D minor chord. Stay with the D minor chord. Now we're going to play the E minor chord. This is the root position. Let's put the E at the top. And now we're going to put the G at the top. E minor, first inversion, second inversion, first inversion, root position. Let's play the F chord, root position, first inversion, put the F at the top, second inversion, put the A at the top. Again, F-A-C, put the F at the top, put the A at the top, second inversion, first inversion, root position, play with the F chord. Let's play the G chord. G-B-D are the notes in the G major chord. First inversion, B-D-G. Second inversion, second inversion, same pattern. Play with the G chord. Now we're going to play the A minor chord. A-C-E, C-E-A is the first position. We're putting the A at the top. E-A-C is the second position or inversion. Second inversion, first inversion, root position. Now play with the A minor chord. Now practice your A minor chord and the different inversions. When you know these six chords and every note that's in these chords and the inversions, there are hundreds and hundreds and hundreds of songs you will be able to play. In the future, if you would like, I will teach you how to play some of my favorite songs. We're just getting started. Have fun!
